description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams to hold and manage search filter parameters for employee directories in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID, along with appropriate getters and setters. The class also sets a default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates search filter parameters for employee directory queries, including employee numbers, name or ID, job title ID, and location ID.

properties.name: ALLOWED_SORT_FIELDS
properties.description: An array of allowed sorting fields, currently empty.

properties.name: empNumbers
properties.description: An array of employee numbers or null.

properties.name: nameOrId
properties.description: A string representing name or ID filter, or null.

properties.name: jobTitleId
properties.description: An integer ID of the job title or null.

properties.name: locationId
properties.description: An integer ID of the location or null.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'employee.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers or null.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter string or null.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter string.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the job title ID or null.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the location ID or null.
